_README: Per-module notes printed in the classify-prep.js worksheets, for curriculum cours whose name doesn't say what they cover. Settle a question once here instead of letting each classifier guess.
s5-pharmacologie: Antithrombotiques 1 = antiagrégants plaquettaires (aspirine, clopidogrel, prasugrel, ticagrélor…).
Antithrombotiques 2 = anticoagulants (héparines HNF/HBPM, fondaparinux, AVK, AOD : apixaban, rivaroxaban…), INR/TCA/anti-Xa monitoring.
The "toxico pharma" exam has no cours in this module: give its questions {"keep": "topic"} instead of a cours.
s5-anatomie-pathologique: The split between "Techniques en anatomie pathologique - partie 1" and "partie 2" is unknown: every techniques question gets both parts.
